part.text:
Fixed the localized float alignment bug in `include/fmt/format.h:2651`.

The padding calculation counted thousands separators over the full significand instead of just the integer part (`exp`), overestimating width and causing under-padding. All 20 CTest suites pass, including `format-test`, `printf-test`, and `xchar-test`.
